dedupe_keys.name: the context dataset containing contextual faults of a smart factory

description: Lukas Kaupp and colleagues publish CONTEXT, recordings of contextual faults in the smart factory at Darmstadt University of Applied Sciences. The November 2020 ZIP provides CSV OPC-UA logs and corresponding machine-sensor logs. The metadata map management, storage, robot, press and inspection stations and explain folder labels for dates, runs, produced relays and fault conditions. Download is free for non-commercial use under CC BY-NC 4.0. These records can calibrate fault-detection or process-state observations in factory simulations. The testbed setting does not establish behaviour at every industrial installation; sampling rates, sensor units and transferability remain uncertain from the public summary. No related catalogue record explicitly covers CONTEXT. The describing publication provides experimental context, but the archive and reported detection results were not reproduced.
